observations.code_quote: /** Bucket size, one of: second_15, second_30, minute, minute_5, minute_15, minute_30, hour, hour_6, day, week; auto-picked from the range when omitted. Fixed intervals are coarsened above 500 buckets. A dashboard variable reference such as `$window` pins the interval to its single duration value (15s, 30s, 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 6h, 1d, 1w). Variable intervals that exceed 500 buckets require a larger value or shorter date range, so the step stays consistent with PromQL lookbacks using that variable. */
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies documentation for the interval parameter in the generated MCP API schema, potentially aiding developer understanding of query behavior.
